## Sky Beak — G4 hippogriff

**Who he is:** The sky-blue, white-crested father of **Silverstream and Terramar**, husband of **Ocean Flow**, and brother-in-law of **Queen Novo**. He lives on Mount Aris and enthusiastically celebrates hippogriff culture, while Ocean Flow prefers underwater Seaquestria. In **“Surf and/or Turf”** they reassure Terramar he can belong to **both** places; they are affectionate co-parents, not stated to be divorced. [Character/episode source](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Sky_Beak_and_Ocean_Flow)

**Look:** Pale periwinkle-blue plumage and wings, a dramatically swept silver-white crest and tail, amber-gold eyes, feathered ankles, and normally a purple cord with a pink pendant. At the festival he briefly sports golden flight armor.

**Name and voice:** **Sky Beak** is the spelling in *Surf and/or Turf*’s credits; **Skybeak** occurs in *A Horse Shoe-In*’s credits and, according to the character wiki, on pp. 184–185 of the 2018 UK *My Little Pony Character Guide*. These are attested production/publishing variants, **not** distinct characters or a fan-invented name. **Speaking role, voiced in English by Brian Dobson.** [Season 8 credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_eight) · [Season 9 credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_nine)

**Where to spot him:** Brief debut in **“School Daze – Part 2”**; prominently hosts the “Glad to Be a Hippogriff” Festival in **“Surf and/or Turf”** (S8E6, 2018); returns in **“Uprooted”**, **“A Horse Shoe-In”** (Silverstream’s parent–teacher meeting), and crowd scenes in **“The Ending of the End – Part 2”** and **“The Last Problem”**. Gameloft’s mobile game also offers a **Rainbowified Sky Beak** variant—an in-game appearance, not a verified secret identity.
